source_observation.behavior: Repeated atomic checks; Pause for the first 16384 iterations, then std::this_thread::yield. Does not use a blocking wait in this path.
source_observation.interpretation: The front spends about56% of elapsed time in drain while consuming about93% of a logical CPU. Active waiting is a concrete target for reducing CPU coordination cost, but a correct notification protocol and actual alternating FPS validation are still required.

decision.next_candidate: Investigate blocking progress notification in GpuSplit::Drain and finer stage-buffer/method profiling. Preserve ordered writes, deferred idle-hook completion and shutdown wakeups. No FPS improvement from such a change demonstrated yet.
